recognize_zh: 極低倍CD56染色的多塊胃腸道黏膜切片：其中一塊幾乎全片呈深棕色陽性，其他碎片呈斑駁至局部陽性，顯示CD56陽性細胞大量浸潤黏膜；此圖解析度低且模糊，無法評估細胞形態，只能看出浸潤的範圍。
features: Scanning-magnification view of several mucosal biopsy fragments stained for CD56
One fragment shows diffuse, intense CD56 positivity throughout the mucosa
Other fragments show patchy to moderate positivity in the lamina propria around negative gland profiles
Image is low resolution and blurred, precluding assessment of cell size, cytology or epitheliotropism
describe_en: Scanning-power CD56 immunohistochemistry of multiple gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy fragments shows extensive CD56-positive infiltration, diffuse and intense in one fragment and patchy in the others, with negative gland profiles discernible within the stained lamina propria. The low resolution of the image does not permit evaluation of cytologic features, depth of involvement or angiodestruction. The distribution indicates a large mucosal NK-cell population; in conjunction with EBER negativity and a non-destructive histology, this is compatible with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows the same CD56 positivity, so EBER positivity and necrotic angiodestructive growth are required to separate it.
MEITL is CD56-positive but is a transmural, epitheliotropic clonal T-cell lymphoma that cannot be excluded at this magnification without TCR studies.
A CD56-positive neuroendocrine tumor would be cytokeratin- and synaptophysin-positive and form organoid nests rather than a lamina propria infiltrate.
